name: Kyung Dong Navien Co., Ltd.
summary: Kyung Dong Navien Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells machinery and heat combustion equipment in South Korea. The company offers gas, oil, and electric boilers; condensing oil and gas boiler; gas and electric water heaters; hot water mats; wired and wireless zone control systems; controllers; home network products, such as IoT products, video phones, lobby phones, sub-phones, door cameras, inter phones, and security office systems; heat pump products, including hybrid and double heat geothermal boilers; m-CHP products; zone control systems; and cascade systems, ventilators, and mid and large-size boilers. It also exports its products. The company was formerly known as Kyungdong Boiler Co., Ltd.…
